public.text: Relationships may imply that one component directly delivers a health outcome, although outcomes depend on adoption, service delivery, workforce, policy, and operational applications.
public.suggestedRevision: Introduce an explicit distinction between infrastructure contribution and outcome achievement. Do not draw a direct causal relationship from a component to a health outcome without intermediate services, adoption, and enabling conditions.
